hints.title: Node Instantiation Table
hints.text: Maintain nodes by value so that parent and child objects are instantiated only once.

hints.title: Child Set Tracking
hints.text: Record every value that appears as a child in descriptions in a set.

hints.title: Root Identification
hints.text: The root of the tree is the unique parent node whose value never appears in the child set.

hints.title: Map-Based Tree Assembly

complexity.notes: Each description edge is processed once, and the root is located in O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching for parent pointers repeatedly without a node registry leads to quadratic runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary of tree nodes uses O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate links nodes in one pass and deduces root through set difference.
